answer: The cipher counter is kept in copper and ferrous shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1887 identities would post 4758 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
